prompt: Create an original 180 second instrumental post-rock instrumental composition for rest, unwinding and breathing exercises. Mood: peaceful, soft, spacious. Instruments: clean electric guitars, electric bass, live drums. Style: delay guitar figures and patient layered crescendos. Tempo approximately 80 BPM; F major. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Use a restrained arrangement, soft attacks, no sudden accents. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A calm and reflective instrumental track featuring clean electric guitars, piano, and synth pads over a steady drum and bass rhythm. It evokes a peaceful yet slightly melancholic atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首平静而富有沉思感的器乐曲，以干净的电吉他、钢琴和合成器铺底为主，配以稳定的鼓点和贝斯节奏。营造出一种宁静而略带忧郁的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
